name: wilanis-js
description: Declarative dataflow graphs, judged by a compiler and run by a stateless engine. The @wilanis/* workspace.
author: Rafael Fontes <rfontes1987@gmail.com>

scripts.check:example: npm run build && wilanis check example
scripts.rehearse:example: npm run build && wilanis rehearse example
scripts.release: npm test && npm publish -w packages/engine -w packages/core -w packages/compiler -w packages/runtime -w packages/plugin-http -w packages/plugin-blob -w packages/view
